ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What do birds feed on in the diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic diagram of a food web. On the right side there is a bird labeled “Bird”, and below the bird there is a maggot labeled “Maggot”. It can be seen that an arrow points from the direction of “Maggot” to “Bird”. Then reason: In a food web, an arrow points to the predator or feeder, indicating that the animal pointed to by the arrow feeds on the organism from which the arrow comes. Therefore, in the figure, the bird feeds on the maggot.
